import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_38/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_38/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source0 and Source1 on 'city'
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by 'type' from Source0 and sum the 'fare' from Source1
grouped = joined.groupby("type", as_index=False)["fare"].sum()

# Convert 'fare' to float explicitly (should already be float, but to ensure)
grouped["fare"] = grouped["fare"].astype(float)

# Reorder columns to match target schema ['type', 'fare']
Target2_38 = grouped[["type", "fare"]]

# Write the result to the specified path without the index
Target2_38.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_38/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
